headline: Critical Langflow code-execution flaws disclosed as GitLab RCE attacks continue; FBI ties $6.3B Binance heist to North Korea

bullets.text: New since the last SITREP: The Hacker News reports critical Langflow flaws that could let unauthenticated attackers run code on servers.
Also new: a second wave of suspected cyberattacks has hit supermarket freezers across Europe, The Record reports. TechCrunch says the attacks destroyed food across countries.

BleepingComputer reports over 1,000 GitLab servers are vulnerable to ongoing RCE attacks. CISA KEV lists the max-severity GitLab CE/EE flaw CVE-2026-97229, whose due date passed on 2026-11-01. Alpine Linux rebuilt its GitLab after an attempted RCE attack.

Binance, 7 outlets: The Register reports the FBI pins the $6.3B heist on North Korean hackers. The Record names TraderTraitor and says the FBI urges the crypto industry to block transactions; SecurityWeek says it flagged over 600 addresses.

Claude, 7 outlets: SecurityWeek reports a malicious Claude Code extension served in a Cursor supply chain attack. BleepingComputer says it planted SSH backdoors; WIRED says malicious Claude extensions reached thousands of devices.

Ivanti patched two more Connect Secure zero-days chained in attacks, CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527. CISA KEV lists CVE-2026-104935 in the same product, with federal due dates of today, 2026-11-02, and 2026-11-13.

actions: Find any Langflow servers, check the vendor advisory for the critical flaws, and patch them. Restrict access to any you cannot patch yet.
Patch GitLab CE/EE (CVE-2026-97229) and Cisco ASA/FTD (CVE-2026-76418) now; both KEV due dates have passed. Check GitLab servers for signs of RCE.
Apply Ivanti's latest Connect Secure patches today, covering CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527, and check appliances for compromise.
If developers use the Claude Code extension in Cursor, check it against the vendor advisory and look for unexpected SSH keys or services.
If you handle crypto transactions, screen against the addresses the FBI flagged for the Binance heist, and warn staff about Binance-themed scams.
Find any LXD and MicroCloud deployments, check the vendor advisory for the CVSS 10.0 flaw, and patch them.
